description: Source code for a mock Security Support Provider Interface (SSPI) library used for testing Windows security context handling, credential management, and package info querying within the Chromium project.

classes.name: MockCredential
classes.description: Represents a mock security credential with source principal, package, and handle storage.

classes.name: MockContext
classes.description: Represents a mock security context with associated credential, target principal, and context state.

methods.name: StoreInHandle
methods.description: Stores the credential or context object into a handle, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: FromHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the credential or context object from a handle.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the mock context.
